Unimpressive.  Nothing special or unique about this game or the mechanics or the graphics or anything.  It's kind of bland and gets repetitive very quickly.  There's no real story to tie things together and if it exists its's buried under mind-numbing repetition ad nauseam.  The gunplay would be satisfying with a little more "oomph" behind the sounds but there's far better gunplay games out there.  It's kind of a "worse" Risk of Rain 2 and Gunfire Reborn.  I found it difficult to stay interested and even more difficult to find people to play.  The Matchmaking appears to need a critical mass of players playing the game but with so many difficulty levels the 600 people playing are completely spread across the tiers.  My guess is that this game was a great vision by a truly visionary imagination who essentially plagiarized everything and then poorly implemented the vision to come to terrible fruition.  The game needs a lot more time to cook for me.  I'm a casual player and an old man and nothing I saw convinced me to spend money.  And I have plenty of money to spend on frivolous stuff.  I didn't enjoy my time in the game until I played with my buddy and his son.  I wish them best of luck finding a market and an audience.

8.5/10

+ Incredible graphics.
+ Vibrant and gorgeous world, characters and artstyle.
+ Beautiful female character design.
+ Jiggle physics. ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)
+ Great optimization; stable 144 fps on max graphics settings on RTX 3070 with zero framerate drops and no screen tearing.
+ Responsive controls; the keybinds can be customized to your liking.
+ Fast and fluid movement controls.
+ Incredibly enjoyable fast-paced looter shooter gameplay with extensive roguelike mechanics.
+ Good aim assist.
+ Visually impressive skill animations and particle effects.
+ 6 unlockable characters at launch each with their own unique skills, weapons and playstyles.
+ Massive variety of perks and relics that offer significant power progression in a run; every run feels fresh and exciting.
+ Perks are extremely powerful and character progression in a run feels impactful and rewarding.
+ Plenty of meta progression and ways to make your character permanently stronger.
+ Gameplay loop is fun and addictive.
+ Enjoyable OST.

- Matchmaking is dead at low difficulties.
- No variation in areas and enemies encountered in each mode; higher difficulties of a particular mode just increase number of enemy spawns and enemy stats.
- Can become repetitive very quickly if playing solo; have to clear the same mode on increasing difficulty an absurd amount of times in order to unlock the next mode.

TLDR: Play with two friends if you want to have fun

The things I like about this game:
Great stylized graphics
Hades style choose your perks with synergies between them
Free to play*
Unique people to play as with each their own abilities
An upgrade system that you basically play Tetris to fit all the things you want to make a person stronger

Things that need to be fixed or outright changed:
The game stutters constantly during actual gameplay
A lot of the matchmaking in this game is broken or non existant due to too many split up modes
A character being locked behind a paywall that will only be accessible after the battle pass ends
Game is free to play yet there is a battle pass that you only obtain via purchase, no possible way to grind for it
Most of the late game modes add no actual difficulty besides the enemies having way too much health
The sorting system for modules is abysmal, slow and hard to navigate easily
There is very little options to change controls for menus i.e. accepting requests, or in alternate game modes
Controller support suffers the same option problem
Sound design on the events gives no actual cues if you have selected things or the menu lags
There is a rare set of modules that can only be obtained through a game mode but in order to beat said game mode you have to "build" a run in another game mode and can only use said sets at most 3 times
Most of the perks obtained from runs are way too underpowered for later game play where as some are necessary for a run to even succeed
The game does a bad job at explaining what a majority of your stats even does or affects
There is a potentials option that shows up after a boss, most of these are useless or downright detrimental to your run and you have to use in run money to refresh your options for some reason

In conclusion:
If you have read all of these things you can tell that there is a lot more problems with the game than there is good. With that in mind it is a free to play live service game so I hope that there will be more tweaks/fixes as the game matures. I say give it a shot with a friend or two you might have some fun early on since you are not being charged anything for the core experience, just as the longer you play this game know that it will be harder and much more repetitive than it should be since a lot of your build freedoms will no longer be viable.
I do enjoy the game a long as you can tell by my play time, just as a solo player doing late season content it is more of a second job than a video game at this point.

Fun Core, But Balance Issues Undercut the Experience

Terminull Brigade has a solid foundation and moments of genuine fun. The combat loop is satisfying when it works, and the world has promise. But character balance is wildly off, and it drags the whole experience down.

- Blade is absurdly broken. You can dominate entire missions just by reloading and bunny-hopping. It’s not just overpowered—it’s boring. The lack of challenge kills the thrill.
- Gloria feels underpowered across the board. Her kit struggles to keep up, especially in higher-tier missions.
- Max is a complete miss. Clunky, ineffective, and frustrating to play.
- Aurora is the standout—well-tuned, versatile, and actually fun.
- Heckynes is another dud. His mechanics feel half-baked and never quite click.

If the devs commit to serious rebalancing, this could be a great game. But right now, it’s hard to recommend without caveats. Proceed with caution—or wait for a patch.

The game is very busy, so its definitely addicting to play in that sense. But the enemy AI is boring and dumb. The boss fights are uninspired and repetitive. Everything feels recycled. And the game seems to only gets harder by giving the enemies more health, so more challenge doesn't mean more fun. If you're looking for some cheap dopamine farming slop to waste time and keep your hands busy, this is the game for you.
